neighbours.label: a word-initial piece that looks like a short common word (' go', ' dam', ' dov', ' claw') but here opens a longer, different word (go|atee, go|thic, dam|ier, dov|etails, claw|-foot); quiet when the same short word stands alone
fire: The barber trimmed his goatee and shaved the rest of his face clean.
The chapel windows are tall and narrow, in a late gothic style with stone tracery.
A pair of goosanders drifted past the weir while we ate our sandwiches.
Her handbag was made of coated canvas in a brown damier pattern with leather trim.
The joiner cut the dovetails by hand and glued the drawer together that evening.
The oak chest has exposed dovetails at each corner and a hinged lid.
They restored the cast-iron claw-foot bath and painted the outside dark green.
The guest room has a brass bed and a claw-foot tub beneath the window.
